name: AMENDMENT_A1
reason: 2026-10-06 engineering amendment (controls stage only). Defect: dpc.audit.split_tokens built planted bits from the permuted/noisy SEX of ALL rows; sealed assessment rows carry -1, giving bits outside {0,1}, colliding split tokens and a refused decoder check, so the controls stage crashed at its first plant before writing any output (log kept in <PRIVATE_CACHE>/dpc_v1/quarantine_amendment_A1). Fix: bits outside {0,1} are set to 0 (plants are fitted and scored on AUDIT_FIT / INNER_SELECTION only); regression test in dpc/tests/test_late.py. The change is confined to split_tokens, which only the controls stage calls: the completed inner audits, selection rules, final audit and assessment code paths are unchanged. Affected stage: controls (rerun after this push).
